title: Serialization of the De Morgan dual
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a CNF formula over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$. Scanning its binary serialization from the formula-level state and flipping the bit read in each polarity state yields exactly the binary serialization of the DNF obtained by negating every literal of $\varphi$ in place.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a CNF formula over variables indexed by $\mathbb{N}$
replaced:
For every CNF formula $\varphi$, the polarity-flipping scan from the formula-level
state of the formula syntax scanner maps the serialization of $\varphi$ to the
serialization of its De Morgan dual, the DNF obtained from $\varphi$ by negating every
literal in place.
